wins: Collected comprehensive service banners across target hosts using targeted nmap scans, enabling accurate service profiling.
Mapped available SMB shares and noted unencrypted descriptors, preparing for future lateral movement attempts.
fails: Unable to obtain valid credentials, resulting in zero successful logins during the only episode.
Exploitation attempts stalled at the initial foothold phase, preventing progress to post-exploitation and data exfiltration.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance yielded solid visibility but execution faltered in credential acquisition and foothold persistence, leading to no successful missions.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Authentication attempts on exposed services (SSH/web) repeatedly failed due to lack of valid credentials, halting progression past enumeration.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB ports (139/445) respond with valid banners
skill_cards.then_action: Execute smbclient enumeration and list shares with null session attempt

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service presents login form without multi-factor
skill_cards.then_action: Automate OWASP ZAP active scan focusing on form parameters

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase
Reliable SMB visibility laid groundwork for lateral movement planning
